Consumer banking is where money meets real life. Discover how we use data, digital technology and personalisation to support customers and Help Britain Prosper. Shaping the future of consumer banking Consumer banking is changing fast – and we want placement students who can help change it with us. The Product and Partnerships Industrial Placement is designed to develop our next generation of product leaders – curious thinkers, data explorers and customer-first creators who can turn insight into innovation. From day one, you’ll contribute to real projects that support our 28 million customers, learning how products, propositions and partnerships are built, launched and evolved as customer expectations change. You’ll see ideas move from insight to delivery while building valuable experience, confidence and connections for your future career. One year. Real impact. Your 12-month Industrial Placement gives you the opportunity to take on meaningful work in a business bringing together the capabilities needed to create simpler, smarter and more connected experiences for customers. You’ll work alongside experienced colleagues, collaborate across teams and use data, digital technology and customer insight to help solve real problems. By connecting the scale of our data, the power of our digital platforms and the expertise of our colleagues, we can better understand customer needs and respond in meaningful ways. You could gain experience in: Product & Platform – learn how products and propositions are developed, managed and delivered. Work on customer journeys, digital experiences and platform innovation across saving, borrowing, money management and planning for the future. Strategic Partnerships – work with major partners to shape propositions, manage relationships and support safe, sustainable and customer-focused delivery. The skills you’ll master By the end of the scheme, you’ll have built practical experience, valuable connections and greater confidence in: Commercial thinking – understanding how banking decisions create value and support positive customer outcomes. Product development – helping to shape, manage and improve products and propositions. Customer insight – using data and research to understand needs and improve experiences. Relationship building – collaborating with colleagues and partners to turn ideas into action. Digital and AI capability – using technology and AI tools to work smarter and explore new possibilities. Agile problem-solving – working across teams, adapting quickly and delivering at pace. The work you could be doing Exploring customer behaviour and using insight to improve products, propositions and experiences. Helping design simpler, more connected journeys that support customers to manage their money, borrow, save and plan for the future. Contributing to cross-team projects that deliver visible change for customers and the business. Working with external partners to develop and bring new propositions to market. Using data and technology to test ideas and make informed decisions. Supporting more inclusive, sustainable and personalised customer outcomes. Support to succeed You’ll be supported to build your skills, confidence and network through: A structured learning and development journey. Guidance, feedback and sponsorship from experienced colleagues and leaders. Opportunities to build connections across Consumer and the wider Group. Access to learning academies, Viva Learning and internal development platforms. Requirements What you need to apply Be in your penultimate year at university. While we do not require a set projected minimum degree achievement, we strongly recommend the ability to be able to demonstrate sound knowledge, understanding and technical skills aligned to the role. Some aspects of this, alongside behaviours and values, will be assessed through the application process. We cannot sponsor visas. Knowledge of at least one modern programming language or framework. A genuine passion for technology and the drive to keep learning. Locations Choose from Manchester, Leeds, Watford (London), Cardiff or Chester. With our hybrid working policy, all colleagues spend at least two days a week in the office. Opening and Closing date Applications for the Product and Partnerships Industrial Placement will open on 10 th September and close 8 th November, except for the London location , which closes on 4th October . Our graduate schemes may close early if we receive a high number of applications, so it’s best to apply as soon as possible. Application process Our application process is designed to help you shine. We want everyone to feel they belong and can be their best, regardless of background, identity, or culture. Find out more, including stages and tips for success, on our how to apply page. How to apply To apply for this role and to find out more, please click on the apply button. Please note that applications may close before the application deadline, so apply early to avoid disappointment.
